title: Open tensor and pullback-compositor coefficient square before proper image
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, its coefficient datum C, a finite extension E of Q_l, n >= 1, and a normalized operation datum S at (E,n) [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Assume l is invertible in D.k. Let o be simultaneous-system operations and z their specified realization data. Let f:X -> Y be a morphism of finite-type spaces over D.k and c=(i:X -> Z,g:Z -> Y) its compactification. Put A=S.higher.integralExchange(identitySquare(f,c)); write red_T for the specified reduction functor and T_T for the system tensor [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data]. Use barTensorReduction, properPullReduction, directReduction and openReduction of [def-sf-integral-projection-middle-map]. Assume f is quasi-compact. Let K and L be constructible derived-complete integral objects on X and Y, with L of uniform finite-reduction Tor amplitude. Put W=S.higher.integralTensor_X(K,S.higher.integral.pull(f)(L)). Let e:A.stage.tensorX(K,A.stage.pull(L))=W be the equality from A.tensorX and A.pull, and q=A.stage.openProjection(K,L) followed by A.stage.openExtension(eqToHom(e)). The composite barTensorReduction(openExtension K,properPull L).hom, T_Z(openReduction K,properPullReduction L), z.openComparisons.projection(i)(red_X K,pull_g red_Y L), and system i-extension of T_X(id, z.compositors.pullComp(i,g).inv followed by transport through c.comm) equals red_Z(q) followed by openReduction(W) followed by system i-extension of inputReduction(f,K,L).inv. Both arrows end at system i-extension of T_X(red_X K,pull_f red_Y L). Neither proper direct image nor compact support occurs in this equality.

theorem integralProjectionOpenTensorCoordinates
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left L.obj) :
    let A := S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)
    let W := ((S.higher.integralTensor X).obj K).obj ((S.higher.integral.pull f).obj L)
    let q := ProjectionFactors.openMap A K L
    (ProjectionFactors.barTensorReduction D C E n hn S hl f c
        (A.stage.openExtension.obj K) (A.stage.properPull.obj L)).hom ≫
      (calculus C.l E c.Z).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom (ProjectionFactors.openReduction D C E n hn S hl o z f c K)
          (ProjectionFactors.properPullReduction D C E n hn S hl o z f c L).hom) ≫
      (z.openComparisons.projection c.i).hom.app
        ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj,
          (pull C.l E c.g).obj ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj)) ≫
      (Operations.shriek C.l E o c.i).map
        ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _)
            ((z.compositors.pullComp c.i c.g).inv.app
                ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj) ≫
              eqToHom (congrArg (fun g : X.obj.left ⟶ Y.obj.left ↦
                (pull C.l E g).obj
                  ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj)) c.comm.symm)))) =
      (calculus C.l E c.Z).reduction.map q.hom ≫
        ProjectionFactors.openReduction D C E n hn S hl o z f c W ≫
        (Operations.shriek C.l E o c.i).map
          (Coordinates.inputReduction D C E S.higher hl o z f K L).inv
